answer: What keeps this honest is double-answer detection via key image, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 479 fakes spends 7185 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The nebula of the design is public, the mesa of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the vertex of honest work is what finally pays. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
